name: How long does it take to see results from AI SEO for a CPA firm?
description: Significant results from AI SEO usually take 6-12 months, with initial improvements potentially visible in 3-6 months, depending on various factors.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to see results from AI SEO for a CPA firm?

acceptedAnswer.text: While AI SEO can accelerate the optimization process, seeing significant results typically takes several months. Initial improvements in visibility and traffic may appear within 3-6 months, but substantial gains in keyword rankings, organic leads, and client conversions often require 6-12 months or more of sustained effort. The exact timeline depends on factors like your firm's current website authority, the competitiveness of your target keywords, and the aggressiveness of the strategy. AI tools help to identify opportunities faster, but search engine algorithms still require time to re-index and re-evaluate your site's relevance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Significant results from AI SEO usually take 6-12 months, with initial improvements potentially visible in 3-6 months, depending on various factors.
